1[378-O. Number of directors.--Every Producer Company shall have at least five and not more than fifteen directors:
Provided that in the case of an inter-State co-operative society incorporated as a Producer Company, such company may have more than fifteen directors for a period of one year from the date of its incorporation as a Producer Company.]
footnote: </br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>1. Ins. by Act 29 of 2020, s. 52 (w.e.f. 11-2-2021).</br><hr style="border-top:1px solid #0778be"/>
